title: kit.release-bootstrap.v1
description: release/bootstrap.json: the receipt of the first production run of a repository in state bootstrap (docs/RELEASE.md). Written by `kit release ship` from a read-only Cloudflare API read of every declared Worker's settings (its BUILD_COMMIT binding) and of its public build endpoint, BEFORE any production change, and completed by `kit release drills` after the deploy; the records pull request commits it with the drill records and sets release.json state to ready. A receipt whose `eligible` is false refuses bootstrap; a receipt with `deployed_commit` set means production exists and bootstrap can never be entered again.

run.description: The GitHub run URL that wrote the receipt.

workers.description: Every declared Worker name → its state before this run, read-only from the account's Workers API: absent; present-unreleased (its version carries no BUILD_COMMIT binding and its public /api/build serves no sha: deployed outside the production workflow); present-released (a BUILD_COMMIT sha in its version, or a sha served on /api/build: a production run deployed it); present-unknown (its settings could not be read). A 404 on /api/build is never evidence; any other unreadable answer of a present Worker with no BUILD_COMMIT (network error, 5xx, a 200 with no readable commit) is present-unknown, which refuses bootstrap.

eligible.description: True only when every declared Worker is absent or present-unreleased: no production run has deployed here, the only state in which bootstrap applies.

deployed_commit.description: Set after the bootstrap run deployed and verified this commit: from then on production exists.

drills.description: The drills the bootstrap run performed (kind:subject).
